ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the diagram: in the diagram there is a D flip-flop, with a D input terminal and clock input C on the left, and output Q and complementary output \overline{Q} on the right. In the diagram, a feedback line is led out from the complementary output \overline{Q} terminal, goes around to the left side of the flip-flop, and is connected to the D input terminal. Then reason: when the active edge of the clock pulse C of the D flip-flop arrives, it satisfies Q_{n+1}=D. Since the D terminal is provided by feedback from the current complementary output \overline{Q}, if the initial state is Q_n, then before the clock arrives D=\overline{Q_n}. Therefore after the clock pulse, the new state of the flip-flop is Q_{n+1}=\overline{Q_n}.
